entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I need to return an item.
I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your account, could I please get your full name and order number?

Thank you, Jane. I see the order for the VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered on December 15th, which was 22 days ago. To make sure I handle this correctly for you, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Does it matter? I don't want it anymore.

I understand, and I apologize if the question seems intrusive. It's just that the reason helps determine the correct next steps. For example, a defect follows a different path than just changing your mind.
Fine. I had an emergency. I was in the hospital, and I had to have surgery. I wasn't exactly focused on your return window.
Oh my, I am very sorry to hear that. I truly hope you are recovering well. Thank you for sharing that with me. Please allow me to place you on a brief hold while I review our policy.
Thank you for your patience, Jane. I've double-checked our policy, and you have nothing to worry about. You are well within the return period.

Yes, absolutely. Our return policy allows for returns up to 90 days from the date of delivery. Since you're only on day 22, I can process this for you immediately. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email we have on file.
So you made me explain my private medical situation for nothing. Whatever.

I sincerely apologize for the unnecessary questions. I was just trying to be thorough. I do see that you're one of our VIP members, and for the trouble and everything you've been through, I've added a $25 VeloFit credit to your account. You can use that anytime.
Fine. Just make sure I get that label.

It's already been sent. Once our warehouse receives the band, you can expect a full refund to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope the rest of your day is a pleasant one.
